create_GettableItem: create a GettableItem with a typeName, optional entityId, position, id metadata, and properties list
update_position_GettableItem: update the position of a GettableItem instance by setting new x, y, z coordinates
add_to_world_GettableItem: add a GettableItem to a Minecraft world by assigning it a new entity ID and random pose
get_info_GettableItem: get a dictionary with all info about a GettableItem including entityId, typeName, position, and properties
attach_to_entity_GettableItem: attach a GettableItem to an entity's inventory by recording the entity's ID as the holder
